coordinates: Saved print XYZ inverted by recorded transform into ENU mm for core comparison
method: Boolean overlap and minimum gap against the true union of all 14 final double-precision cutters. Negative shells reversed to represent their enclosed cavity volume.
limitations: Geometric separation only; no physical print or flow qualification.
A 5 mm distance value is a capped search result, meaning at least 5 mm.
A failed or unclassifiable separation gate must be reviewed and must not be bypassed solely because a shell is small.
Core hash manifest must match the final cutters used in the delivered generation pipeline.
